messages:
emily: Heads-up: planning a 12h mixed soak + burst test tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need a quick review of the k6 scenarios — bursts are 10k RPS for 30s every 10m on top of a 4k RPS steady load. Will replay traffic from 2026-02-10 prod window. Who can look?

raj: I can take a look. What's our SLA target here — p95 for end-to-end or token-level?

emily: p95 end-to-end < 300ms (model + runtime). token latency can spike but overall request should stay under 300ms.

maria: That burst pattern will wreck batching unless we handle arrival rate properly. Suggest separate scenarios (steady vs burst), use ramping-arrival-rate for the burst, and add a short priming run to warm KV cache. Also split inference vs preprocessing paths if possible so autoscaler can react to inference load only.

jordan: +1. Example options I was about to paste — baseline + burst scenario, thresholds for p95, and tuned preAllocatedVUs/maxVUs. Something like:

```js
export let options = {
  scenarios: {
    steady: {
      executor: 'constant-arrival-rate',
      rate: 4000,
      timeUnit: '1s',
      duration: '12h',
      preAllocatedVUs: 200,
      maxVUs: 2000
    },
    burst: {
      executor: 'ramping-arrival-rate',
      startRate: 4000,
      stages: [
        { target: 10000, duration: '30s' },
        { target: 4000, duration: '30s' }
      ],
      timeUnit: '1s',
      duration: '12h',
      preAllocatedVUs: 500,
      maxVUs: 5000
    }
  },
  thresholds: {
    'http_req_duration': ['p(95)<300']
  }
}
```

raj: Nice. Also consider seeding the KV/cache with a small dataset prior to the main test so we don't conflate cold-cache effects with capacity regressions. We should also limit per-agent concurrency so single runner doesn't hoard tokens used for batching.

emily: Good call — we'll run a 15m priming job at 08:45 UTC at ~200 RPS. For replay: we'll use the replay tool with the following command to stream traces into k6 (will attach dataset to PR):

```bash
replayctl start --source s3://replay-bucket/2026-02-10-window.json --mode k6 --mapping replay-to-inference.json --start 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z
```

loadbot: test scheduled by emily: 2026-03-20 09:00 UTC. Runner pool: 40 x r5.large. Expected max VUs ~4200. Priming run at 08:45 UTC. Notifying on #eng-runtime.

sre_lead: Quick ops notes — disable canary routing and any autoscaler safety limits that will kill pods under heavy short bursts (we want graceful scaling). Also add a fallback route to a smaller model variant if p95 > 400ms for 2m to protect downstream customers.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll review the PR once you push the k6 options + replay mapping. Please tag @maria and include a short grafana dashboard link for p95, error-rate, and queue-depth.

emily: Thanks everyone — I'll open PR #912 with the config and dataset pointer in the next 30m and ping again once it's up.
